Name: Confused Tortillas
Author: EnderTedi
Description:
The recent attempts at recentering the Tortilla have caused... let's just say unwanted effects on the Tortilla population at large.
Now look at what you've done, you monster. They're [i]confused [/i]because of [i]your[/i] attempts to recenter them.

[size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
- Confused Tortillas
- They will wiggle your tables. This is not a bug, this is an intentional feature.
- Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37258]Recentered Tortillas[/url]. Yes I accounted for Recentered Tortillas they will wiggle the exact same way without being an extra pixel to the left. You're welcome!﻿


Curious how it works? Or Confused just like the Tortillas?
[url=https://github.com/EnderTedi/ConfusedTortilla]Check out the source code.[/url]
